Upper Text: [When Digivolving] You may trash the top card of your security stack to reveal the top 6 cards of your deck. Add up to 2 level 6 or lower Digimon cards among them to your hand. Trash the remaining cards.[All Turns][Once Per Turn] When a card is removed from your security stack, if you have 3 or fewer security cards, trigger ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞. (Place the top card of your deck on top of your security stack.)
